source: Best Buy Canada public catalogue search API
purpose: Reference catalogue for a Ghana demo storefront. Prices belong to the Canadian source; availability, local prices and stock are not verified for Ghana.
imageProvenance: Original product photograph URLs supplied by Best Buy Canada; selected digital gift cards use a verified 500px rendition of the source thumbnail. Refer to source listing for image ownership.
specificationProvenance: Product names and descriptions reproduced from source catalogue. Brand derived only from explicit known brand names in titles. No Ghana stock claims or ratings.
deduplication: Unique source SKU plus normalized title stripping colour names and punctuation; vinyl colour-edition labels and gift-card denominations deduplicated. Source-category and title relevance checked per leaf. Refurbished, open-box, pre-owned and renewed listings omitted.
